about: PrivatePaste E2E cross-client test vectors (protocol 2), generated by tests/PrivatePaste.Tests/Protocol/VaultCryptoTests.cs with PP_WRITE_VECTORS=1. All byte values are lowercase hex unless the field name says otherwise. vaultKey: vk (32-byte vault key) -> encKey, hashKey (HKDF-SHA256, no salt, info 'privatepaste v1 enc' / 'privatepaste v1 hash') and keyId (first 8 bytes of HKDF info 'privatepaste v1 key id'). payload: small item 0x01 || nonce || ciphertext || tag under encKey with AAD 'privatepaste v1 ' + purpose; json is the UTF-8 plaintext, sealed the full output. blob: chunked format 0x02 || noncePrefix, then 1 MiB chunks; plaintext byte i = i % 251 for plaintextLength bytes; only SHA-256 digests and the length of the output are stored. emptyBlob: the full output for an empty plaintext (one final chunk). keyedHash: text -> contentHash (ContentHash.ForText) -> keyedHash = HMAC-SHA256(hashKey, UTF-8 of contentHash). handover: blob is otk-sealed small item with AAD 'privatepaste v1 handover' and plaintext vk; qrText uses id, base64url otk without padding, and keyId. argon2: passphrase -> key cases (passphrase as a UTF-8 string, NFC and NFD forms must agree); passphraseWrap: the VK wrapped under a passphrase key. Both are added by the passphrase task.
